latency.Scope: Completed minute windows selected by log UTC end, including the partial pre-open minute and excluding any unreported tail. Means are event-weighted; events include both bid and ask. These windows differ from Parquet audit cutoffs. SDK dispatch is connection-wide batch-drain time, not wire latency.

gaps.reason: Tick coverage unknown during process or broker interruption; minute bars do not repair ticks.

evaluationBlocker.Error: Evaluation range is too short for the configured training, validation and untouched holdout windows.

limitations: Software baseline replay, not an approved ML model or actual IBKR fills.
Four independent chronological batches: warmup, capital and position state restart. Sums are descriptive, not a continuous portfolio equity curve.
Four filled positions have unknown exits after quote gaps; their unknown PnL is excluded. Incomplete filled positions block later entries until batch end.
Quote gaps exceeding three seconds are conservative coverage failures, not proof of network loss. No gap threshold was relaxed.
Gross PnL already includes spread and slippage; net also subtracts commission and hypothetical safety buffer.
131 complete counterfactual labels include overlapping and blocked candidates; they are not 131 independent portfolio trades.
All 21 closed baseline trades exit by timer and lose net; this short sample does not validate the strategy or justify tuning on holdout.
Only 1436 final 5s windows are countable across four as-of cutoffs; do not report 1433/1440 as data completeness.
One receive age >2s pair follows recorded broker reconnect. Other pipeline spikes are separate and root cause remains unmeasured.
Current evaluator accepts one explicit completed FX ReplayRunId; it does not merge these batches into a multi-day training set.
Two-hour sample and 200000-event per-replay bound do not satisfy configured multi-day validation. No model was trained or approved.
